# Dockio

Dockio is led by founder Sankalp More and supports enterprise AI product owners, programme/delivery leads, and sponsors.

Services: AI business analysis, requirements/use-case/value prioritization, embedded PM/PMO delivery coordination, governed AI tasks/skills/tools, adoption, and selective development.

Engagements use agreed hours or days on time and materials. Scope, rate, review cadence, founder involvement, availability, and delivery responsibilities are agreed before work begins. Finance is the preferred starting point; global and cross-industry enquiries are welcome. Remote delivery or other working arrangements are agreed per engagement.

Examples are illustrative, not client wins or guaranteed outcomes. Dockio is independent.

Services: https://www.dockio.in/#/services
Contact: https://www.dockio.in/#/contact
